title: Step 3 — BCCR mints 10,000,000 fCeBM against the deposit
description: The fiat exchange mints fCeBM — the ERC-20 fiat token on Besu — to the payer bank's Besu operator address. This is the first on-chain movement of the flow.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway (spoke-crc). The approve/reject/exchange half of the reserve lifecycle is registered only on a Central Bank gateway and is gated to ROLE_TREASURY; a commercial-bank gateway answers 404 on this path. Path divergence between scenarios: Scenario A serves this at deposits/fiat-exchange, Scenario B at deposits/exchange; no gateway serves both. Field divergence, verified in the delivered gateway (FiatExchangeResult): the 201 body is {mint_tx_hash}, not the {tx_hash} that the Scenario A OpenAPI document and contracts/pvp declare.
